product_summary: Additional borrowing against existing home loan for personal or professional needs like marriage, education, business expansion, or debt consolidation with minimal documentation.

pricing.other_charges_notes: Part payment charges: 2.5% + taxes for amounts exceeding 25% of principal outstanding. No charges for part prepayment up to 25% once per financial year. Premature closure charges: 2.5% for fixed rate loans. Payment return charge: Rs 450. Repayment schedule change: Rs 50 per instance (digital free). Repayment mode change: Rs 500. Custody charges: Rs 1000/month beyond 60 days. CERSAI charges: Rs 100 per property.

collateral_accepted: Security interest on property being financed
Other collateral/interim security as required by bank
documents_required: Income Tax Returns for at least 2 Assessment Years
Balance Sheet and Profit & Loss statements for 2 years (CA attested)
Title deeds and previous property documents
Passport size photographs of all applicants
Declaration for end use of loan
Directors and shareholders list with shareholding
key_features: End to end digital process with approval in 4 simple steps
Available for existing customers and new Balance Transfer customers
Can be combined with Balance Transfer facility
Applicable 12 months after final disbursement of existing home loan
Requires possession/completion of existing financed property
Maximum tenure of 15 years or till retirement age (whichever is lower)
Available for personal and professional needs excluding speculative purposes
fees_table_raw: Loan Processing Charges: Maximum 1% of loan amount (Minimum Rs 7,500). Pre-Payment/Part Payment Charges (Floating): No charges for 25% of principal outstanding once per financial year; 2.5% + taxes for amounts exceeding 25%; Nil for individual borrowers for non-business purposes; Nil for MSEs. Pre-Payment/Part Payment Charges (Fixed): Maximum 2.5% of principal outstanding; Nil after 60 months; Nil for MSEs up to Rs 50 lakh. Premature Closure (Floating-Business): 2.5% of principal outstanding; Nil after 60 months. Premature Closure (Floating-Non-Business): Nil. Premature Closure (Fixed): 2.5% + taxes of principal outstanding; Nil after 60 months. Payment Return Charges: Rs 450. Repayment Schedule Changes: Rs 50 per instance (Digital free). Repayment Mode Change: Rs 500. Custody Charges: Rs 1000/month for non-collection beyond 60 days. Revision in Spread: 0.1% of principal outstanding or Rs 5,000 whichever is higher. Stamp Duty & Statutory Charges: As per applicable laws. Conversion Charges (BPLR/Base rate/MCLR to Policy Repo Rate): Nil for existing customers. CERSAI Charges: Rs 100 per property. Property Swapping/Partial Release: 0.1% of loan amount (Min Rs 10,000, Max Rs 25,000 per property). Document Retrieval: Rs 75 per document set. Senior citizen discount: 10% on all service charges.
